Container.Name: McPanel
Container.Overview:
McPanel runs your Minecraft servers at home: Paper, Vanilla, Fabric (Java) and Bedrock, from one simple web panel. It downloads the server software and the right Java version for you.
- Add, start, stop and restart servers, with a live console and command history - Players page: who's online, kick, operators, bans, the whitelist, and an Allow button for anyone who was turned away - Settings as plain labelled controls, plus a raw server.properties editor - Search Modrinth for plugins and mods that match your exact version - Import a server or world from another host as a zip - Scheduled backups made while the server keeps running, with one-click restore - Crash restarts, version changes that keep your worlds, and two-factor sign-in
PORTS: new servers pick their ports automatically from 25565-25575 (Java, TCP) and 19132-19141 (Bedrock, UDP). Widen these ranges if you run more servers. To play with friends outside your network, forward the server's port on your router. Bedrock players joining a Paper server (through Geyser) use one of the 19132-19141 ports over both UDP and TCP, so forward both on your router.
After it starts, open the WebUI and choose your password. The setup code is in the container's log.
Container.Requires: A free IP address on your home network for the container (Network Type: br0, Fixed IP address). It can't run on Unraid's own IP or on the bridge network.
